# Sunken Realms

Solo developer Brad Warren of Magic Puncher Games has announced that Sunken Realms, an action RPG dungeon crawler with rogue-lite elements, will launch on Steam on 18th September 2026. The game has been in development for six years, and with over 10,000 players already having wishlisted it, there is clearly an appetite for what Warren has been building. [...] Sunken Realms is an action RPG dungeon crawler with rogue-lite elements, developed solo by Brad Warren of Magic Puncher Games. Players explore the cursed underground city of Aedaria, battling enemies, collecting loot, and uncovering a personal story across multiple runs.

  When does Sunken Realms release and what platforms is it on?

Sunken Realms launches on Steam on 18th September 2026. No other platforms have been announced at this time.

  What are the key features of Sunken Realms? [...] A new trailer has been released alongside the announcement. Sunken Realms launches on Steam on 18th September 2026, and players can add it to their wishlist now via the game’s Steam page. For more information, keep an eye on Magic Puncher Games.
